payload.text: The Brennecke Institute originated a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery designed to reduce electrolyte crossover. Its corrected cycle life is 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee; the earlier 12,000-cycle claim was retracted after an independent audit found it used an un-normalized depth of discharge. The battery has a gravimetric energy density of 148 Wh/kg, a projected stack-level cost of $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale, and an operating-temperature floor of 4 °C, below which the dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.

FLAGS: "12,000 cycles" versus "8,400 cycles" (explicitly retracted and corrected by the independent audit).
VERDICT: APPROVE
